metadata.description: Learn what data the Vekaro website collects, why, and what rights you have. Information about cookies and Google Analytics.

privacyPage.title: Privacy and Cookie Policy
privacyPage.intro: This is an informational website presenting Vekaro car rental in Warsaw. We aim to collect as little data as possible. Below we explain what data we process, why, and what rights you have.

blocks.text: The controller of your personal data is the entity operating this website. For any questions about personal data, contact us by phone at {phone}.

sections.title: What data we process and why

blocks.text: This website has no booking forms and no user accounts. Rental agreements are concluded in person with our representative, and the rules for processing data in connection with an agreement are provided separately when it is concluded.

items: Technical data (server logs): IP address, browser type, date and time of the visit, and the page visited. Purpose: keeping the website secure and working properly. Legal basis: the controller's legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Necessary cookies: remembering your chosen language and your cookie consent choice. Purpose: the website working properly. Legal basis: the controller's legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Analytics data (Google Analytics 4): information about how you use the website, such as pages visited, traffic source, device type and approximate location. Purpose: visit statistics and improving the website. Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). Analytics only starts after you give consent.

Data you provide when contacting us: when you call or message us on WhatsApp, Telegram or Instagram, we process the data you share, such as your name, phone number and message content. Purpose: replying to your inquiry and presenting an offer. Legal basis: taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and the controller's legitimate interest in handling inquiries (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

blocks.text: Cookies are small text files saved on your device. We use necessary cookies, which the website needs to work, and analytics cookies, which we set only after you give consent. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time using the "Cookie settings" link in the footer of the page. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings, but some functions of the website may then stop working.

Your data may be processed by the hosting provider that runs our website server, and by Google for analytics, only with your consent. If you contact us via WhatsApp, Telegram or Instagram, the providers of those messengers also process data within their services, under their own privacy policies. Some of these providers may transfer data outside the European Economic Area, including to the United States. This takes place on the basis of mechanisms provided for in the GDPR, such as a European Commission adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses. We do not sell your data.

items: Server logs: for the period set by our hosting provider, and no longer than necessary to keep the website secure.
Analytics data: according to the retention setting in our Google Analytics account, no longer than 14 months.
Messages and data shared when contacting us: for as long as needed to handle your inquiry. If an agreement is concluded, we process data under the rules provided when it is concluded.
Cookies: for the periods shown in the table above.
object to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR),
withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal (Art. 7(3) GDPR).

blocks.text: To exercise these rights, contact us by phone at {phone}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office in Poland (ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw).
We do not make automated decisions about you that would produce legal effects.
We publish the current version of this policy on this page together with the date of the last update. Last updated: {lastUpdated}.

about.title: About Vekaro
paragraphs: Vekaro is a local car rental company in Warsaw with over 7 years of experience. We offer short-term and long-term car rental, as well as vehicles for businesses, with rental terms tailored to individual needs.

We focus on direct communication, clear rental conditions, and practical solutions. Our team helps customers choose the right vehicle and provides support throughout the rental process. With our own car service facility and experienced mechanics, we ensure regular maintenance of our fleet.

items.question: Can I drive the rental car abroad?
items.answer: No, Vekaro rental vehicles can only be used within Poland. You can travel throughout the country, but driving across international borders is not permitted. If you're planning a longer trip, contact our team to discuss the rental details.

items.question: How can I book a car?
items.answer: To book a car with Vekaro, simply contact us by phone, WhatsApp, or Telegram. Our team will help you check vehicle availability, choose a suitable model, and confirm your rental dates and terms. We currently accept bookings directly rather than through an online booking system.

items.question: What cars are available at Vekaro?
items.answer: Our current fleet includes the Fiat Tipo and Skoda Citigo. These vehicles are suitable for everyday driving in Warsaw and trips across Poland. We are gradually expanding our fleet, so please contact our team to confirm which models are available for your dates.

items.question: What is the minimum car rental period?
items.answer: The minimum short-term rental period at Vekaro is 24 hours. You can rent a car for one day, a weekend, or longer, depending on your needs. We also offer long-term rentals and rental solutions for businesses.
